t: You're on London Bridge, a road bridge over the Thames between the City of London and Southwark. This one opened in 1973 and is built of concrete and steel. It replaced a nineteenth-century stone bridge, which in turn replaced a medieval one that lasted about six hundred years and once carried homes and businesses along its length. The very first crossing was a timber bridge built by the Romans around AD 50. The Welsh soldier Sir Matthew Gough, who served in the Hundred Years' War, died here.
